patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layouts are used for project showcases, pairing a large heading and description on one side with a dynamically placed, often tilted, visual on the other.

A sophisticated, elegant serif font is prominently used for main headings and project titles, creating a strong editorial feel, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and client lists.
A muted, off-white background serves as a minimalist canvas, allowing vibrant and dynamic colors from the hero video and project imagery to act as primary accents against dark, elegant typography.
The hero section features a scroll-triggered transition where an initial static, minimalist illustration is dynamically replaced by a full-bleed, abstract video background as the user scrolls down.
Content sections and individual project elements reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a guided viewing experience.
The client list is presented as a horizontally scrolling or marquee-like string of names, separated by dots, distinct from the vertically stacked project listings.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-triggered visual transformation where an initial static image is smoothly replaced by a full-screen, abstract video as the user scrolls past a certain point. The video then plays in the background, creating a dynamic visual anchor.

Content sections and individual project items are introduced with a staggered reveal animation, typically a subtle fade-up or slide-in from the bottom, as they become visible within the browser's viewport.

The main navigation elements, including the site logo and hamburger menu, are designed to remain fixed at the top of the screen, providing persistent access as the user scrolls through the page content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text, and an extremely oversized, bold sans-serif for the footer brand name.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic, scroll-triggered hero transition, where a minimalist static illustration gives way to a vibrant, full-screen abstract video, immediately establishes its expertise in motion design. This, combined with the elegant typography and airy layout, creates a sophisticated and memorable brand experience.
